```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### LaTeX Typesetting

`TeX()` wraps a string in `$...$` so plotly.js typesets it with MathJax.
`config(mathjax = "cdn")` loads MathJax from a CDN; `config(mathjax = "local")`
uses the copy bundled with plotly.core and works offline.

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    y = c(1, 4, 9, 16),
    name = TeX("\\alpha_{1c} = 352 \\pm 11 \\text{ km s}^{-1}")
  ) |>
  add_scatter(
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    y = c(0.5, 2, 4.5, 8),
    name = TeX("\\beta_{1c} = 25 \\pm 11 \\text{ km s}^{-1}")
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    xaxis = go_xaxis(
      title = TeX("\\sqrt{(n_\\text{c}(t|{T_\\text{early}}))}")
    ),
    yaxis = go_yaxis(title = TeX("d, r \\text{ (solar radius)}"))
  ) |>
  config(mathjax = "cdn")
```

#### Reference

See `TeX()` and `config()` for more information.
